sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 3 January 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000005-P1 was put before Sunrise Care Partners 005 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 3 rebate of 6 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Tdap minimum take of 1,030 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
